facts.fact: 全书开篇立论：比好笑话更好的，是极其糟糕的笑话
facts.anchor: The only thing better than a good joke is a really, really bad joke.

facts.fact: 作者承认「好笑话」有大量研究支撑：改善社交、情绪乃至免疫
facts.anchor: There has been endless research done into the positive effects of humour in social connections, improving one’s mood and even helping to boost one’s immune system.

facts.fact: 幽默把人联结起来，正在逗你笑的人你恨不起来
facts.anchor: It unites us as humans. You can’t hate someone who is making you laugh.

facts.fact: 作者把好笑话比作独木舟：一件有实际功能的家伙
facts.anchor: Think of it like a canoe: a functional item that does a job and gets you from A to B.

facts.fact: 全书约 700 条笑话，其中很多根本不好
facts.anchor: There are 700-ish jokes in this book, and a lot of them aren’t any good at all.

facts.fact: 坏笑话分几类：老套可预测、生硬难懂、以及故意写坏
facts.anchor: Some are corny and predictable, some are contrived and difficult, and others are wilfully bad.

facts.fact: 坏笑话的乐趣来自「兴高采烈的讲法」与「失望或愤怒的反应」之间的错位
facts.anchor: the mismatch between a joyful delivery and a disappointed or angry response

facts.fact: 结尾双关：改写 have your cake and eat it too，落到 kayak（独木舟）与 heat（加热）
facts.anchor: you can have your kayak and heat it too.
